title: Clinical Data Monitor I
description:
At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word-a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care-we’re changing lives.
We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: “What would I do if this patient were my mom?” That question drives everything we do.
But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare-driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.
Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.
Job Description
Position Summary
The Clinical Data Monitor is responsible for clinical data management activities for the Caris sponsored and collaborating protocols and projects. This role ensures the highest standards of data integrity and quality in support of critical research efforts to improve treatment, health, and medical outcomes for oncology patients. The Clinical Data Monitor I provides support to both external and internal research coordinators in patient enrollment, data collection, and data query resolution. Responsibilities include oversight and management of clinical investigative sites in accordance with Federal Code of Regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Good Registry Practices (GRP), ICH Guidelines, local regulations, and applicable Compliance and Sponsor SOPs.
Job Responsibilities

• Maintains proficient knowledge of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems to support training, change proposals, and user acceptance testing.

• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with site data and regulatory coordinators.

• Perform quality control review of submitted Case Report Forms (CRFs), including source document verification and issuance of data queries.

• Serve as an evaluator for internal Clinical Research Coordinators in training and provide detailed, constructive feedback.

• Maintain regulatory documentation for all assigned sites and study staff.

• Create and manage site records within the EDC for newly onboarded sites.

• Conduct quality control audits of the clinical database.

• Ensure compliance with GCP guidelines, FDA, Institutional Review Board (IRB), HIPAA regulations, site operating procedures, and ethical standards for the conduct of clinical research.

• Collaborate closely with onsite teams to confirm appropriate consenting is completed and documented prior to data abstraction.

• Communicate effectively with research teams, investigators, study sponsors, and ancillary staff.

Required Qualifications

• Requires 3-5 years of experience in data collection activities within a GCP regulated clinical research environment.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

• Experience working with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.

• Clinical study experience in oncology.

• Strong understanding of medical terminology.

• Ability to work independently and make sound decisions.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Demonstrated ability to build trust with site personnel and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• High attention to detail with a passion for contributing to meaningful research outcomes for patients.

• Strong problem solving skills and the ability to deliver practical solutions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Professional demeanor with positive, collaborative interactions with internal and external partners.

• Ability to propose, implement, and evaluate appropriate resolutions to issues.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree preferred

• Research Coordinator certificat

description:

Built with leading healthcare systems, Axuall is a clinical workforce intelligence company built on top of a national real-time practitioner data network. It enables healthcare systems, staffing firms, telehealth organizations, and health plans to accelerate clinician onboarding, improve hiring and workforce planning, and maintain accurate provider data across enterprise systems. By delivering trusted data, AI-powered insights, and seamless data exchange, Axuall empowers healthcare organizations to improve operational efficiency, strengthen clinical coverage, and support revenue capture.
Axuall 's investors and the organizations they represent comprise over two dozen of the nation's leading healthcare organizations that recognize the imperative to improve clinical workforce efficiency amid significant economic and staffing challenges.
About the Role
Axuall is building a formal Customer Success function, and this role is foundational to that effort. The Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) will partner directly with the SVP of Customer Experience to design, stand up, and operationalize Axuall 's customer success program from the ground up - establishing the playbooks, engagement model, and success metrics - while also owning a portfolio of accounts and driving adoption, satisfaction, and retention across the full Axuall platform.
This is a build-and-run role: part program architect, part practitioner. The Sr. CSM will work cross-functionally with Account Management, Client Services, and Implementation to ensure a seamless, connected customer journey across all Axuall solutions (Confirm, Explore, and Sync). Program Foundation

• Identify and close structural gaps in the current customer journey, particularly proactive adoption ownership.

Adoption & Relationship Management

• Own a portfolio of customer relationships post-implementation, driving solution adoption and utilization and alleviating pain points across the full Axuall platform (Confirm, Explore, and Sync).

- Experience driving a corporate sustainability agenda forward, ideally within a progressive or tech-led organisation

description:
Senior Campus Experience Manager

ABOUT EXPERIENCE BY INDUSTRIOUS

Experience by Industrious is a workplace hospitality brand launched by CBRE - built on the idea that where you work should actually feel like somewhere worth showing up to. We combine CBRE's real estate scale with Industrious' operating model to run dedicated experience teams across office assets, enterprise headquarters, healthcare facilities, and logistics centers worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You're the person who makes buildings feel alive. Not in a vague way, but in a real, every-single-day way. The tenants who grab coffee know your name. Property management calls you first when something goes sideways. The leasing team wants you on their tours because you make the space feel like somewhere people actually want to show up.

As a Senior Campus Experience Manager, you own the full on-site experience for large commercial assets across a dynamic NY campus: community programming, amenity operations, meeting and event sales, lobby arrivals, building communications, and the team that delivers all of it. You're the single point of accountability for how these buildings feel to everyone who walks through their doors.

It's a general manager role with a hospitality soul. Part of your day will be coaching your team, part of it troubleshooting with vendors, part of it thinking three months ahead on programming and budgets. The variety isn't a side effect of the job. It is the job.

The buildings that work best aren't just well-run. They're places tenants talk about, renew in, and bring clients to. That's what you're here to build.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Tenants feel genuinely known and cared for. They're not just occupying square footage; they're part of something you've built.

• The building team runs smoothly whether you're there or not. Your systems, standards, and culture do the heavy lifting.

• Asset and property management teams trust your judgment. They look forward to your quarterly recaps because they're honest, specific, and useful.

• The building's NPS trends upward quarter over quarter, and you have a clear story for why.

• Your direct reports are growing. They have clear goals, real feedback, and feel like they're in the right place.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE AND SUCCEED AT IT IF

• You're a natural GM, not just a great operator. You think about the whole building (people, programs, spaces, revenue), not just your piece of it. Owning an outcome end-to-end is what gets you out of bed.

• People tend to trust you quickly, and you're not entirely sure why. Tenants like you before they have a reason to. Your team works hard because they want to, not because they have to. You've always been this way.

• Details don't fall through the cracks with you. You're the one who notices the signage is off-brand, that a vendor hasn't confirmed, that the meeting room wasn't reset. And you handle it without being asked.

• You can sell, and you actually enjoy it. Meeting and event revenue is real here. You're comfortable with outbound strategy, inbound follow-up, and a Tripleseat pipeline, without losing the human touch in any of it.

• You coach as naturally as you operate. You know how to set expectations, give feedback in the moment, and have the harder conversation when it's needed. People get better at their jobs from working with you.

• You're comfortable being accountable for things you don't fully control. Third-party vendors, property management, leasing teams, you set the service culture across all of them without having direct authority over most of them.

• You move between big picture and ground level without losing your footing. You can walk a quarterly recap with an asset manager in the morning and personally reset a meeting room before a VIP tour in the afternoon. Both feel equally important to you.

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You do your best work in a clearly defined lane. This role has a lot of lanes, and most days you're driving in several of them

One out of every three cancer patients has a diagnosed mental health condition but only 25% of them receive treatment for their mental health challenges, exacerbating quality of life, worsening health outcomes, and increasing their total cost of care to the system. title: AI Performance Engineer
description:
AI Performance Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Performance Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $75,000-$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Performance Engineer to focus on extracting maximum throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing cost across training and inference workloads for large neural network systems. The role spans the full stack from low-level kernel optimization to distributed system tuning, requiring deep understanding of GPU architecture, model parallelism, memory management, and compiler-level optimization. The ideal candidate has demonstrated impact on production AI workloads, with strong instrumentation and measurement discipline that enables rigorous, data-driven optimization decisions. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Six or more years of experience in performance engineering, ML systems, or HPC.

• Strong proficiency in Python and C++.

• Hands-on experience optimizing deep learning workloads on modern GPUs.

• Deep understanding of distributed training and inference techniques.

• Experience with profiling tools across CPU, GPU, and distributed systems.

• Familiarity with model compression techniques and their accuracy implications.

• Strong grasp of memory hierarchies, communication primitives, and parallelism strategies.

• Excellent measurement, debugging, and analytical reasoning skills.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience optimizing LLM inference at production scale.

• Contributions to vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, or similar projects.

• Familiarity with custom kernel authoring in Triton or CUTLASS.

• Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.

• Publications or talks on AI systems performance.

The Center for Food Safety and Applied Nutrition (CFSAN) is the branch of the United States Food and Drug Administration that regulates food, dietary supplements, cosmetics, drugs, biologics, medical devices, and radiological products.

• The scope of this contract is to provide the full range of technical and management services necessary to develop, maintain, and enhance CFSAN systems. The general requirements include providing Custom Computer Programming Services (NAICS 541511) to the FDA and CFSAN; and to maintain, support, and evolve code, scripts, views, triggers, jobs, designs, documentation, reports, and templates.

• There is also a need to establish an ordering vehicle that develops and maintains existing and future Computer to Plate (CTP) systems, which will process structured and unstructured data. The FDA expects between 2-5 new applications/systems to be added to the BPA per year over the duration of this contract. The ProSidian Engagement Team shall provide training services to CFSAN stakeholders for existing applications, application changes, or newly-developed applications. CFSAN will issue individual Task Orders for the Contractor to provide IT Lifecycle Support for the CFSAN IT portfolio of systems as needed. Representative tasks to be performed.

THE BLANKET PURCHASE AGREEMENT IS DIVIDED INTO THE FOLLOWING (9) TASK AREAS:

• Task 1: Project Management: Task Order level project management to establish control, management, monitoring and notification mechanisms to ensure the individual task orders stay on track to meet the important milestones and performance measures within the awarded task. | DOCUMENTATION: The Contractor shall use FDA supplied templates which will be provided on each individual Task Order as applicable. If an FDA template does not exist, the Contractor may be tasked with drafting a template for approval by the COR.

• Task 2: O&M and DME Architecture Support Services: The Contractor shall provide the full range of architecture support services in order to formulate the integrated, end-to-end automated systems that provide enhanced IT capabilities necessary to support CFSAN business and mission processes. title: Senior Product Manager, Partnerships
description:
About Us
We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.
Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.
About the Role
What we don't have is a product-minded presence in the market: someone in the rooms where the platforms decide what's next, who comes back with the story early enough for us to act first.
You are that presence. You source strategic signal in the field, vet it commercially, and feed it into the partner product machine - so Fundraise Up shapes ecosystem shifts like Agentforce and agentic commerce instead of finding out after they ship.
This is a market-facing product role: not business development (you don't own accounts or commercial terms), and not platform PM (you don't run the roadmap). You are the counterpart every strong partner product organization pairs with its builders.
Travel: up to 30% - covers roughly 2-3 Salesforce conferences a year, HubSpot Unbound, Stripe and Visa events, 1-2 Microsoft events, plus in-person partner and agency meetings.
What You’ll Own

•
Represent Product in the Ecosystem: Build standing relationships with product and solution leaders at Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft, Stripe - and with the principals of major fundraising agencies and consultancies; aspirationally Meta and Google.

•
Bring Back the Story: Go into the field and return with the raw material of a product story: what the partner ecosystem is about to need, who confirms it, and what it's worth - written up as a light-weight spec.

•
Bring Product Truth to the Market: Know the platform at architecture depth - what exists, what's being built, what we can and can't do - and vet every partner opportunity against that reality before anything is promised.

What You’ll Do

• Work the rooms that matter: Dreamforce, HubSpot Unbound, ecosystem summits - every event produces a written outcome memo with implications, not a trip report.

• Own the agentic-commerce watch: Stripe / Visa / PayPal / Agentforce moves, tracked early enough to act first.

• Source the agency and reseller motion: wedge plays, white-label demand, and warm-door opportunities.

• Land every signal in the shared signal intake, where the PM for Partnership Experience turns patterns into quantified bets. The bar is first-to-market timing: signal delivered before the platform ships, not after.

• Represent product live in US rooms: answer capability and architecture questions with authority.

• Complement PMM, don't duplicate it: PMM owns ICP, co-marketing, and launch motions; this role feeds them product-grounded narrative and feasibility-checked cases.

Deliberately not in this role: product roadmap and prioritization, execution through engineering/design, integrations delivery, partner account ownership, and commercial terms. Those owners exist; this role makes them faster and better-informed.
Skills and Qualifications

•
Ecosystem-native : Direct experience inside one of the Salesforce / HubSpot / Stripe partner ecosystems, adjacent partner-domain experience working with these platforms, or a demonstrable ability to build this kind of relationship network from scratch - any of the three counts.

•
Commercial fluency: Can size a market motion - ICP, mechanics, revenue logic - not just describe it.

•
Product-deep: Builds and maintains architecture-level knowledge of the platform - capabilities, integrations, multi-tenancy, what's coming - enough to hold any technical room without owning delive

title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer

A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. <p

Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Thermal Engineering team enables Anduril’s rapid hardware development cycle by ensuring advanced defense systems perform reliably in demanding real-world environments. The team works across high-power, tightly integrated products where thermal architecture, analysis, testing, and cross-functional design decisions directly affect product performance, reliability, and mission success.  

About the Role

We are looking for Thermal Engineer to work in Costa Mesa, CA, focused on the thermal design of electronic assemblies. You will own the thermal architecture of these across products spanning air vehicles (fixed wing & rotorcraft), maritime and ground systems, and wearables/body-worn devices, and you will bring an in-depth understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics to bear on hardware that must survive real operational environments.

What You'll Do

• Own the thermal design and analysis of electronics-from board and component level up through enclosures and full assemblies-for products across air vehicles, maritime and ground systems, and wearables/body-worn devices.

• Use first principles as the basis for every decision and discern the right level of analysis to apply. Execute hand calculations, spreadsheets, and MATLAB/Python first-order models to inform the path forward before jumping into detailed design.

• Define thermal architecture and heat-rejection paths-conduction, natural and forced convection, cold plates, heat sinks, heat pipes, thermal interface materials, and coatings-to keep components within junction and touch-temperature limits across demanding environments.

• Establish hot, cold, and edge-case operating conditions for each platform based on industry standards and intended use, accounting for altitude and flight envelopes on air vehicles, salt fog and humidity in maritime environments, solar load and enclosed cabinets on ground systems, and human-contact and comfort limits on wearables.

• Work with electrical, mechanical, and systems engineers to characterize and document component power dissipation under different operating modes.

• Communicate the pros and cons of system and packaging architectures with respect to thermal considerations, and drive trade studies that balance thermal margin against size, weight, and power.

• Own the thermal FEA/CFD models and predict system performance. Define red/yellow design limits for test and operation.

• Define and execute prototype builds and tests to verify thermal designs (do CAD, select sensors and DAQ equipment, post-process data, summarize results, etc.).

• Present thermal status at formal reviews internally and with customers. Provide a clear understanding of timelines and technical status.

• Develop internal tools to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of analysis.

• Support failure reviews and root-cause analysis with test data and thermal analysis.

Required Qualifications

• MS or higher degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field with a focus on heat transfer and fluid dynamics (BS with additional experience considered)

• In-depth understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics fundamentals

title: Creative & Communication Strategist
description:
En Boomit trabajamos con marcas que crecen en serio. Nuestro equipo de Growth Marketing combina estrategia, medios y creatividad para generar resultados reales - y hoy buscamos a alguien que sea el puente entre todo eso.
Buscamos una persona con cabeza creativa y lógica publicitaria: que sepa conceptualizar una campaña, escribir un copy que convierta, leer métricas y volver al brief con más criterio que antes. Alguien que entienda que creatividad sin estrategia es decoración, y estrategia sin creatividad es ruido.
¿Qué vas a hacer?

•

Traducir necesidades de clientes y equipos de medios en briefs claros, con enfoque de mensaje, jerarquía comunicacional y concepto creativo definido.

•

Desarrollar conceptos de campaña, ángulos de comunicación y adaptaciones por canal, formato y audiencia (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn y más).

•

Escribir y revisar copies, guiones y bajadas para piezas estáticas y video - cuidando calidad comunicacional, tono de marca y adecuación al objetivo publicitario.

•

Leer métricas de performance, identificar qué anuncios están funcionando, detectar patrones y proponer ajustes desde la comunicación.

•

Interactuar con clientes en temas de mensajes, feedback creativo y ajustes - con madurez y capacidad de sostener criterio.

•

Trabajar de forma transversal con Performance Leaders, Paid Media Specialists y diseñadores, elevando el estándar creativo de todo el equipo.

Lo que buscamos

•

Experiencia en agencia o ecosistema similar - entendés la dinámica, los tiempos y lo que significa trabajar con múltiples marcas a la vez.

•

Excelente nivel de redacción y conceptualización. Criterio propio, voz propia, capacidad de tomar definiciones y defenderlas.

•

Creatividad aplicada a publicidad: pensar campañas, construir ángulos, generar ideas que luego se puedan ejecutar con claridad.

•

Conocimiento sólido de medios digitales - Meta, Google, TikTok - desde el lado creativo y comunicacional.

•

Comodidad con números: leer planillas, interpretar KPIs y convertir resultados en decisiones de mensaje.

•

Capacidad de dialogar con clientes y diseñadores por igual: argumentar, persuadir, ordenar conversaciones con madurez.

El perfil que nos entusiasma
Una persona apasionada por la comunicación y la publicidad, con sensibilidad creativa y lógica analítica al mismo tiempo. Alguien inquieto, profesional, que disfruta moverse entre un concepto de campaña, una métrica de performance y una conversación con un cliente - y que en cada uno de esos momentos agrega valor real. Que use la IA como palanca para ir más lejos, no como sustituto del criterio.
Modalidad: Remoto full-time. Colaborás con equipos en distintos países de Latam.

- Design and implement React-based features for web applications that work with real-time and historical aviation data.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
✨ About the Company

Makeship empowers influencers, creators, and brands of all sizes to develop and launch limited-edition products that matter to their fans. Leveraging our design, manufacturing, and marketing expertise, we work with our partners to bring their products to life through our community-powered crowdfunding platform. Each product is given a window of 21 days to be funded by the community before we produce and ship to fans worldwide. We put our brand behind every product and guarantee quality and ethical sourcing.

We're profitable, we have a three-year revenue growth of over 200%, ranking us 97th in 2024 and 86th on The Globe and Mail’s  Canada’s Top Growing Companies of 2025  list. We are also excited to announce that Makeship has officially been  Great Place to Work-Certified™  for 3 years in a row! Learn more about us at  Makeship.com .

🧑‍💻 About the Role

During this exciting phase of our growth, you’ll play a huge role in shaping our culture, our process, and the future of Makeship. Every day, you’ll collaborate, learn more about the content creation space, and watch your work impact the company and the community!

We want this to be the best work experience of your life, so we’ll pay you well, offer great benefits, invest deeply in your growth, and welcome you with our branded swag. You will also be joining one of Canada's fastest-growing start-ups!

🌟 What We Are Looking For

A marketing leader who would excel in a role that is equal parts strategy and hands-on execution. We are looking for someone who can dial all the way up to departmental strategy and then back down to how to make an individual creator’s launch stand out, then execute on the strategy.

This role requires an individual who prefers to operate with high autonomy and accountability but who also takes a high degree of pride in keeping everyone looped into their progress, updates, and work.

Preference for individuals who have managed paid agencies before and who are strong in social. Design skills and aesthetic are a plus.

🚀 Your Key Responsibilities

• Input on strategy. Be able to critique and input on existing high-level departmental plans. 

• Shape launch strategy. Come to the table with cool, exciting, unexpected activation ideas, not just campaign execution. You should be excited to go deep into an IP's lore and fandom to find the angle that makes a launch feel special.

• Work the agency relationship. Be our day-to-day partner with our paid marketing agency: brief them, keep the strategy sharp, make sure their ad creative and media plans are performing and that the ads they are putting out feel fan .

• Own design & social execution. Be able to bring campaigns to life across channels with a sharp eye for what looks and feels on-brand.

• Write (really well). Write original, fun copy that sounds fan native. You'll be hands-on with copy across social, campaign, and launch materials, and should be an excellent, above-average copywriter/editor - someone who can make on-brand feel genuine.

• Operate independently. This is a self-sufficient, self-starting role. You should be comfortable owning a project end-to-end, building processes that don’t exist and enforcing follow-through across stakeholders, flagging risks early, and contributing to high-level strategy conversations.

🧠 What You Bring

• 5-7 years of marketing generalist experience. Expertise in social media, email marketing and design. Experience managing agency partners.

• A strategic thinker who is energized by getting into the weeds.

• Genuine curiosity about fandoms, IP, and pop culture, with the instinct to translate “what fans love about this” into activation ideas that feel authentic rather than corporate.

• A sharp, funny, versatile writer and editor rolled into one.

• Scrappy and resourceful by nature.

• Highly self-sufficient, organized, and comfortable with ambiguity - this role will need to prioritize across two teams (CoLabs and Flagship) during ramp-up.

For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 38,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020-2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

As Director, Airline & Car Rental Partnerships , you will lead Engine’s strategy and execution across air and car rental supply - owning senior relationships with airlines and car rental partners and shaping how these suppliers are integrated into Engine’s platform.

This role serves as the senior external face of Engine to airline and car rental partners and is responsible for securing, growing, and evolving strategic partnerships that improve customer experience, coverage, and long-term economics. You will bring deep industry credibility, existing executive relationships, and strong judgment to help Engine scale Flights and Cars as core capabilities.

This is a senior role operating at the intersection of supply strategy, product, commercial, and pricing. You will act as the single-threaded owner for air supply initiatives, driving clear recommendations, execution, and outcomes across airline partnerships, connectivity models, and commercial alignment.

This role provides deep airline domain expertise, structured judgment, and execution leadership to inform and support those decisions as flights continue to scale as a core Engine capability.

• Lead the strategy and execution for Engine’s air and car rental supply ecosystem aligned to 2026 priorities

• Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap for supplier coverage, connectivity, and commercial alignment

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Operations to translate strategy into delivered outcomes

• Provide clear recommendations on tradeoffs across customer experience, coverage, performance, and margin

• Track and report on air supply KPIs to measure progress against strategy

• Monitor industry dynamics across airline commercial, distribution technology, regulatory, and competitive landscapes to inform Engine’s long-term positioning

What We’re Looking For

• 10+ years of experience in airline distribution, supply strategy, partnerships, or commercial roles

• Deep existing relationships with airlines (and ideally car rental brands), with demonstrated ability to engage credibly at the executive level

• Strong understanding of airline distribution models (GDS, NDC, ancillaries, fare structures) and car rental commercial constructs

• Proven track record negotiating and scaling complex supplier partnerships with meaningful commercial impact

• Strong strategic judgment with the ability to balance experience, coverage, performance, and economics

• Clear, executive-level written and verbal communication skills

• Comfort operating in ambiguity and making tradeoff-driven decisions

Nice to Have

title: Deputy Editor, Future Perfect
description:
Vox Media employees thrive on innovation and change while ambitiously seeking to master their subject areas, hone their craft, and improve their communities. We help smart, talented, creative professionals make a meaningful impact in media, technology, and the world around them.
Our Future Perfect section is an especially exciting place for that mission to come alive. Future Perfect covers the world through a particular prism: What are the best ways to do good in this world? Inspired and informed by effective altruism, Future Perfect strives to shine a light on neglected stories that have, or will have, a profound impact on the lives of billions of humans and animals.
Vox is looking for a deputy editor for Future Perfect. We want a self-starter who will help drive daily coverage on Future Perfect, oversee our freelance program, and edit and manage three of our writers: Sigal Samuel, Kenny Torrella and Marina Bolotnikova. This person will also assist the Future Perfect editor in overall management of the section and its staff, and will run the section in conjunction with their fellow deputy editor when the section editor is absent. This is a permanent full-time staff position.
Among our key subject areas include:

• Global poverty and public health

• The catastrophic and existential threats, both natural and technological, that humanity faces

• Animal welfare and factory farming

• The growth of progress studies and evidence-based policies that can boost sustainable growth for all

• The frontiers of artificial intelligence and biotechnology

• The philosophies and practices surrounding philanthropy and altruism, and the moral and ethical questions that underpin individual and policy choices.

Since its launch in 2018, Future Perfect has developed a loyal following for its idiosyncratic, mission-driven approach to news. Our coverage is animated by a baseline question: what’s truly important that we need to cover -- not what’s in the news, not what’s trending on Twitter, but the stories that we think truly matter for human and animal lives and the future? Then we go ahead and do those stories today.
What you'll do:

• Manage and edit three staff writers - soliciting ideas, selecting stories, editing text and managing their advancement at Vox Media . Their focuses include ethics, AI safety and policy, animal welfare and factory farming, and effective policymaking in areas like housing and science.

• Editing our biweekly newsletter on Processing Meat, written by Kenny Torrella

• Assist the Future Perfect editorial director in setting and keeping priorities, both daily and over the medium and long term projects - especially in the area of agriculture and animal welfare - and stepping in to help lead the staff as a whole when he is away

• Commission and edit occasional pieces for the Future Perfect site

What you’ll bring:

• Minimum 5 years’ experience editing, or equivalent

• Strong managerial philosophy and communication skills; previous management experience is desirable but not a requirement

• A passion for mentoring, managing and editing writers

• A demonstrated ability to bring analysis and sharp angles to news stories, as well as well as skill with handling collaborations with audio and video teams

• An understanding of the importance of careful editing, coupled with the ability to build and shepherd big ideas

• Experience in and enthusiasm for diving into research literature, particularly in economics, psychology, sociology, political science, biology/medicine, and computer science is desirable

To apply, please submit a résumé, cover letter, and 3-5 clips that you’ve edited or written (clips can either be linked in your cover letter or included as additional pages to your cover letter).
In your one-page cover letter, please be sure to address the following questions: What appeals to you about working at Vox’s Future Perfect? What’s your management and mentoring philosophy for working with writers?

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.
Job Overview
The Senior, Project Management has direct responsibility for the administration and implementation of all assigned construction and capital projects. The Senior, Project Management coordinates with contracted suppliers and store management to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Senior, Project Management serves as the primary point of contact for the Store Environment teams, disseminating information and facilitating critical project decisions from inception to turnover. The role emphasizes improving the customer shopping experience and requires adaptability to change, consistently championing initiatives that reduce costs and save time. The Senior, Project Management demonstrates a strong sense of urgency and performs effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.

• Collaborate with store, district, and regional partners, as well as suppliers, to resolve property damage claims efficiently.

• Support the Store Environment team and store organization in efforts to drive sales growth.

• Mentor and coach Project Managers as needed or upon request.

• Maintain regular, dependable attendance and punctuality.

• Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Strategic Planning & Execution : Capable of developing phasing plans, project schedules, and strategic initiatives to refine and improve project operations and management processes.
